Notas:
SNR (Signal To Noise Ratio): represents the relationship between the signal and noise at a logarithm scale (dB)
CCQ (Client Connection Quality): it’s a percentage value to show the bandwidth efficiency. Its average is given by Tmin/Treal, where Tmin is the data transmission time that would be considered in a best condition (without any bit error rate) and Treal is the transmission time in a real situation, in other words, considering the data retransmissions and synchronized data rate
CPU: indicates the CPU consumption
These wireless information, like synchronized data rate, signal strength, SNR and CCQ were obtained from the client side
Tests durations were performed for 30s (minimum duration)
